description: This file defines the 'Featured' controller class for the OpenCart platform, responsible for handling the display of featured products in a module. It loads necessary models and views, retrieves product data, processes images, prices, and other product details, and renders the view if products are available.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for handling the featured products module in OpenCart, extending the core Controller class and providing functionality to load and display featured products with their images, prices, and links.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads language settings, retrieves products based on provided settings, processes product images and pricing, and renders the featured products view.
